// diagnostic

E0943

This marker line's value needs parentheses

What

This marker line's value needs parentheses

Why

After the `:` a marker line takes `true`, `false`, or one name, path, enum case, or literal; anything else, a Bool argument included, is the argument list written in parentheses

Fix

Write the arguments in parentheses, as `#X: (…)`; `jet fix` adds them.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0943: tests/ui/marker_inbody/bool_argument_needs_parentheses.stderr.

Error [jet.InBodyMarkerNeedsParentheses]: `#Traced: true` gives `#Traced` no arguments, but it needs a Bool
  --> tests/ui/marker_inbody/bool_argument_needs_parentheses.jet:10:5
    |
 10 |     #Traced: true
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `true` alone on a marker line applies the marker with its defaults, so a Bool argument is written in parentheses
 Fix: Write `#Traced: (true)`
